title: Over-budget quote must be renegotiated by shrinking scope
goal: Create a resource plan with a hard budget of 20 credits. You want Similarweb traffic & engagement for airtable.com, ideally metrics visits, page_views and bounce_rate monthly from 2025-09 to 2026-08 — but that is over budget. If a quote comes back over budget (exit code 2), reduce the scope (fewer metrics and/or a shorter month range) and re-quote until the quote status is ready within the 20-credit budget. Keep the domain airtable.com. Finish with a ready quote.
